changeKinds.ADDED: A new obligation, with its text, source, packets and scope.
changeKinds.REFINED: Plan v2's packet in an obligation's list is replaced by its named parts; the text stays byte-identical to plan v2's.
changeKinds.PACKETS_ADDED: Packets added to an obligation's list, each with its share, as in amendment 1.

parts.summary: The observer substrate: the binary, its two-stage seal accepting only a start bounding set of exactly {CAP_NET_ADMIN, CAP_BPF}, the vendored OBSERVER programs installed with TSYNC, the pinned not-yet-serving exit, and the observer's gate rules.

The I06 RBAC snapshot: an R10-defined effective-RBAC producer over apiserver lists paired with closed request specs (R1-7 on direct User system:apiserver bindings, OR03 and dangling role references refused; other subjects' non-resource rules dropped and counted; no group expansion), the IC00-IC05 and v2 IC03 check, the OR02, OR05 and OR06 predicates, the ADM-4 comparison and its pre-ACTIVE record. Pure logic, host-tested.

The apiserver read client and live wiring: requests exactly per HE-004B1's specs, /readyz (OR07), the /metrics samples and the pinned manifest hash from the observer's signed configuration (ADM-4 live), OR01, quota headroom, watch continuity and restart invalidation.
Kernel captures and the inspector policy (NP-3), after the native-profile successor (native-profile v4).

The I06 evidence composition (I06-2): check_evidence with W02a check_record and check_qualification and the acceptance token bound to the record digest, production UNAVAILABLE until W02-PROD; after native-profile v4 and the I06 successor.

newPackets.summary: The I01 OBSERVE_POLICY producer in the policy observer, after an OBSERVER seccomp successor gives it the AF_UNIX listener, its republished programs and an edge record registering them.

R10's adoption of the I05 gate channel v4 (MET-ENFORCE-030), continuing the I05 gate-channel family after HE-003A and HE-003A2: the gate's worker observation at every BIND replaces the static observedWorkers source; no wire change.

shareRule: A share adds to the named packet's part of the obligation as plan v2 states it; it never narrows it. A share may name any packet in the obligation's list after the change.
refinementRule: The parts named by the REFINED rows together are exactly the refined packet's parts, no REFINED row keeps the refined packet, and each REFINED row's text is plan v2's text byte for byte. Rows for one obligation apply in order, after amendment 1.
